verdict.rationale: Agent-oriented documentation is a fair question for a game engine with a large official docs site, so the axis applies. Probes found no llms.txt on godotengine.org or docs.godotengine.org (HTTP 404) and no .md mirrors of docs pages. The Asset Library JSON API and the built-in GDScript LSP are tooling surfaces, not agent-oriented docs, so they are not credited here.
